role: Whole voucher / habit and reproductive reference
creator: UT Plant Resources Center / University of Texas Herbarium
source_context: Existing exact current-concept voucher under historical Chamaesyce villifera treatment.

role: Field close-up / opposite leaves, stem, and cyathia
creator: UT Austin BIO406D PlantPics
source_context: Exact-species field close-up retained for private visual study; no public reuse claim asserted.

role: Capsule close-up / glabrous fruit with elongated pointed lobes
creator: Nathan Taylor
source_context: Look at the smooth green capsule and its prolonged pointed lobes. This outside view supports capsule shape; an empty internal tip requires dissection and is not proved by this photograph.

role: Leaf pubescence close-up / long soft hairs and smooth capsule
creator: Matt Berger
source_context: Long hairs are conspicuous on the leaves and stem; the capsule beside them is smooth. Hairiness supports identification but does not exclude sparsely hairy E. villifera.

role: Leaf surface close-up / sparsely hairy form and opposite asymmetric leaves
creator: Eric Keith
source_context: Compare this sparsely hairy Bandera plant with the hairy leaf view. Surface texture is visible, but this photograph is not a microscopic verification of individual papillae or stipules.

creator: Carlos Martorell
source_context: Separated reproductive material is shown on a palm. Individual pieces are not confidently assigned as seeds, capsule parts or seed coats; do not score mature seed surface, color or angularity from this photograph.

role: Leaf surface and node close-up / fine texture in a sparsely hairy form
creator: Russell Pfau
source_context: Look at the finely textured leaf blades and the leaf bases at the lower-right node. Small pale appendages are visible there, but cellular papilla anatomy and stipule-versus-hair identity are not resolved sufficiently to close the microscopic gaps.

role: Node close-up / leaf attachments and narrow pale appendages
creator: Chet Burrier
source_context: Look at the junction of the opposite leaf stalks with the red stem and the narrow pale appendages at the lower-left node. This is a node-location guide; do not treat every pale thread as a verified stipule. The smooth capsule is shown externally.

role: Joey Santore close-up / cyathium, capsule and villous leaves
creator: Joey Santore
source_context: Look at the central cyathium above the smooth capsule, beside the long-haired leaves. This exact-species field photo complements the sparse-hair views; it does not resolve seeds, dissected capsule tips or individual stipules.
